verdict.rationale: LiteLLM lets users configure event-driven behaviors within the gateway. It falls back to another model group when a call fails after num_retries, and it has a content-policy-specific fallback for ContentPolicyViolationError. It also supports cooldowns and retries on failure, and Custom Callbacks run custom code or hit API endpoints on logged request events. These are fixed, domain-specific triggers rather than a general rules engine, so it only partly matches the story. Missing for 10: a general user-defined event→action rule system (arbitrary triggers, conditions and actions such as webhooks or workflows), documentation of event-triggered alerting or actions beyond fallback, logging callbacks and budget enforcement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
